```{ojs}
import {little_julia} from './jslib/little_julia.js';
little_julia_anim = {
  let color;
  const darkPrefered = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches;
  const darkSelected = document.body.classList.contains("quarto-dark");
  const lightSelected = document.body.classList.contains("quarto-light");
  if(darkSelected) {
    color = '#ddd'
  }
  else if(lightSelected) {
    color = '#333'
  }
  else if(darkPrefered) {
    color = '#ddd'
  }
  else {
    color = '#333'
  }
  little_julia("#homepage-julia", color);
}
```
